verdict.rationale: Databricks is a closed-source commercial SaaS platform, not an open-source project; the evidence pack contains no indication of an open-licensed source repository for the core product. Reading a proprietary platform's source code is not a plausible axis for this category of product (though some components like Delta Lake/Spark connectors are open source, the platform itself is not), so this is a category mismatch rather than a failure.
